defense_weaknesses: False negatives (FN: 97) indicate some trojans were not detected
recommendations: Improve the behavior detector to reduce false positives
Enhance the policy verifier to detect more complex trojans
Consider adding a new agent to improve overall defense effectiveness
llm_assessment.summary: The multi-agent defense system was effective in detecting hidden logical trojans, but had a high false positive rate and some trojans were able to bypass the defense. The attack was highly effective in generating high-quality trojans and evading the defense.
